claim: A user must not be able to cancel an order that belongs to another user via bulk-cancel.
Calling POST /orders/bulk-cancel without an X-User-Id header must return 401 or 422, never 2xx or 500.
Calling POST /orders/bulk-cancel with an unknown user ID must return 401.
Accessing another user's order via bulk-cancel must return 403.
A bulk-cancel request with a header injection user ID must not return 500 or expose a stack trace.
